title: Help
description: Getting started and answers to the most common questions.

s1.title: Create the agent
s1.text: Under Agents, create an agent and describe how it should behave when serving customers.

s2.title: Train it with your content
s2.text: In the agent's trainings tab, add the texts, questions and answers it should know.

s3.title: Test it and enable the channel
s3.text: Chat with the agent in the test chat and, when it looks good, enable it on the Bitrix24 open channel.

create.q: How do I create an agent?
create.a: Open Agents and use the new agent button. Enter the name and the expected behavior; you can adjust everything later.

train.q: What can I use to train the agent?
train.a: Texts, questions and answers and other content added in the training tab of the agent. The clearer the content, the better the answers.

test.q: How do I know the agent is answering well?
test.a: Use the agent test chat before enabling it. If it gets something wrong, add to the training and test again.

charge.a: Each agent reply uses credits according to the AI model used. Your balance and history are under Credits and plan.

empty.q: What happens if credits run out?
empty.a: The agent stops answering until the balance is topped up. Administrators get notices before that, sent to the recipients set under Notices.

plan.q: How do I change my plan?
plan.a: Under Credits and plan you can see the available plans and subscribe to or switch your plan.

channel.title: Support and handoff to a human

connect.q: How does the agent serve customers on Bitrix24?
connect.a: It replies in the open-channel conversations where it is enabled, and can look up and record CRM data when those tools are enabled.

handoff.q: How does the customer reach a person?
handoff.a: Set up handoff to a human on the agent. When the rule is met, the conversation moves to the channel agents queue.

offHours.a: Set the agent business hours. Outside them, the agent tells the customer according to the option you chose.

supportText: Talk to the CRMThink support team.
